text: Meet Adlumi: the fastest way to find the competitor ads that are actually winning.
Still scrolling the Ad Library for hours, guessing which ads really work?
Just search any brand or keyword in the Meta Ad Library.
Adlumi instantly shows how long every ad has been running, and how many variations the advertiser is scaling.
Save every ad on the page with one click.
Everything lands in your own library. Sort by Winning Score, and the strongest ads rise straight to the top.
Open any ad to see estimated spend, CPM, cost per purchase and ROAS, shown as honest ranges with a confidence level.
Market Intelligence shows who dominates your niche, and which angles, offers and hooks appear most in winning ads.
Deep-dive any competitor in one click: their spend run-rate, launch cadence, and every funnel page.
And it's private by design. No account, no tracking. Your research stays in your browser.
Adlumi. Competitor ad research for Chrome. Get it free on the Chrome Web Store.
